# 3 bed townhouse for sale

> P. Marry & Associates presents to the market this spacious and well proportioned three bedroom town house with converted attic located in the desirable Mill View development. Within two minutes’ walk of the Mill and Mill pond and all the recreational facilities it provides and just a short walk from the town centre, shops, church and beaches.

## Fakta
- Typ: townhouse
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 106 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: 15, Millview, Skerries
- Cena: 575 000 €
